query:
SELECT cs.periodoCustoId, pc.mes, pc.ano, cs.producaoTotal 
FROM custo_setor cs 
INNER JOIN periodo_custo pc ON cs.periodoCustoId = pc.id 
WHERE pc.mes IN (2,3) AND pc.ano = 2026 
GROUP BY cs.periodoCustoId, pc.mes, pc.ano, cs.producaoTotal 
LIMIT 5;
